basis: Immune dysregulation; recurrent oral/GI ulceration affects >60%. Joint complaints (~30-40%) combine arthralgia and arthritis, so destructive/inflammatory joint involvement is not established at >=30%.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: reported joint involvement (~30-40%) includes arthralgia; inflammatory arthritis alone is not established in >=30%.

basis: Anterior horn disease with near-universal denervation atrophy; persistent skeletal-muscle tissue loss and functional impairment are integral manifestations, not a separate disease.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: characteristic, near-universal denervation atrophy represents persistent muscle tissue loss, beyond weakness alone.

basis: Defining chronic airway disease; persistent middle-ear inflammation/effusion affects most PCD patients (>50%). Hearing impairment here is 5-29%; situs reversal alone causes no cardiac damage.

decisions.otologic: involved: chronic middle-ear disease affects >50% in the usual PCD course; the 5-29% hearing-loss annotation does not measure the frequency of persistent otitis.

basis: Cortical malformation with developmental disability and epilepsy. Esotropia (5/5) reflects abnormal neurologic gaze control; intrinsic ocular damage is not established.

decisions.ocular: none: esotropia in 5/5 establishes gaze misalignment, but not direct eye injury; the defining pathology is cerebral.

basis: Defining lung disease and T-cell immunodeficiency; eczematoid dermatitis occurs in 2/4 (50%). Cerebral calcification (2/2) lacks established functional injury; developmental-delay frequency is unknown.

decisions.neurologic: none: calcification in 2/2 does not itself establish damaging deposition; mild developmental delay has no frequency establishing involvement in >=30%.

basis: Inherited redox-enzyme deficiency impairs hemoglobin function. Neurologic injury occurs mainly in minority generalized type II (<30% overall); the 1/1 HPO sample does not represent both types.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: methemoglobin reductase deficiency is an inborn disorder of enzymatic redox metabolism, as well as a blood disorder.

basis: Ovarian endocrine failure defines disease. Osteoporosis (2/5) is a separate hypoestrogenic complication; unspecified dentition abnormalities (2/5) do not establish damaging dental involvement.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: dentition abnormalities occur in 2/5 (40%), but their unspecified nature does not establish structural injury or loss of function.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: osteoporosis in 2/5 (40%) is a separately diagnosed complication of estrogen deficiency, rather than defining skeletal disease.

basis: Mitochondrial translation/oxidative-phosphorylation disorder. Leukoencephalopathy and infantile cardiomyopathy define different presentations; their frequencies across this umbrella are unestablished.

decisions.neurologic: none: leukoencephalopathy defines one presentation; its frequency across the entire AARS2-related umbrella is not established at >=30%.

basis: Callosal agenesis 27/27; immune deficiency and cardiomyopathy 80-99%; cataracts 22/27 (~81%). Cap omits renal anomalies/RTA and myopathy (9/27); hypopigmentation alone is non-damaging.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: cardiomyopathy is a principal defining feature (80-99%); its severity supports prioritization within the three-primary cap.
decisions.ocular: involved: cataracts affect 22/27 (~81%); retained as the fourth axis after prioritizing defining neurologic, immune and cardiac disease.

basis: Craniosynostosis/scoliosis define syndrome; ID 3/3, hearing loss 2/2 and severe visual loss 1/1. Cap omits dental/anal anomalies; single-case anemia does not establish an intrinsic blood disorder.

decisions.neurologic: involved: intellectual disability in 3/3 and motor delay in 4/4 establish common neurologic dysfunction; neither is established as a defining diagnostic criterion here.
